description.fr-FR: Le traité du bon confesseur : ses qualités, sa conduite envers les pénitents, la manière d’entendre les confessions.
description.en-US: The treatise on the good confessor: his qualities, his conduct toward penitents, the manner of hearing confessions.
description.pt-BR: O tratado do bom confessor: suas qualidades, sua conduta com os penitentes, a maneira de ouvir confissões.

fr-FR.editor: Charles Lebrun, Ange Le Doré, Joseph Dauphin (Congrégation de Jésus et Marie)

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du Vénérable Jean Eudes, tome 4, Vannes (Lafolye) et Paris (Beauchesne), 1905–1911, éd. Ch. Lebrun, A. Le Doré, J. Dauphin; transcription Bibliothèque Saint Libère (liberius.net), 2008.
sources.description: Born-digital transcription of the 1905–11 edition, converted by script: page markers and running heads removed, hyphenation and leaked letter-spacing repaired, paragraphs rejoined; the editors’ footnotes are gathered at the end of the file where they fall; footnote call numbers stay in the running text. The editors’ introductions are kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Eudes died in 1680; the 1905–11 edition is public domain.
